component.name: Zone Launcher
component.summary: Run the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. trilogy natively with OpenXRay

description.p: Zone Launcher finds your copies of Shadow of Chernobyl, Clear Sky and Call of Pripyat (from GOG via Heroic, Steam, or any folder) and runs them with the OpenXRay engine.

Before each launch it checks the game folder and fixes common problems, such as the missing English language pack that stops Clear Sky from starting a new game. You need to own the games; no game files are included.
